name: nauka
description: NAUKA — AI-powered learning app (web + mobile): upload your materials, get quizzes, flashcards and mini-games.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nauka/shared && npm run build -w @nauka/ai
scripts.web:build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nauka/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @nauka/web && npm run typecheck -w @nauka/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w @nauka/shared && npm test -w @nauka/ai
